commit.message:
fix(agent-mesh): decay trust for agents without a positive signal (#4297)

apply_temporal_decay measured idle time from the last positive signal and
defaulted it to the current pass for agents that never had one, so their
elapsed time was always zero and they never decayed. Start the clock at
the first decay pass that sees such an agent instead; that first pass
still applies no decay.

Signed-off-by: Shivam Sharma <192242476+ShivamSharma43@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

@@ -156,6 +156,11 @@ and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0
   O(log n) per append (worst-case O(n) when tree capacity doubles). Exported
   `merkle_root` values change for the affected sizes; see
   `BREAKING_CHANGES.md`.
+- `NetworkTrustEngine.apply_temporal_decay()` now decays agents that never
+  received a positive signal. Their last-signal time defaulted to the current
+  pass, so they never decayed at all, against spec §12.1. The clock now starts
+  at the first decay pass that sees the agent, so a new agent still does not
+  decay on that first pass.
 
 ### Changed

@@ -241,10 +241,15 @@ def apply_temporal_decay(self, now: Optional[float] = None) -> Dict[str, float]:
         now = now or time.time()
         deltas: Dict[str, float] = {}
         for agent_did, score in list(self._scores.items()):
+            if agent_did not in self._last_positive and agent_did not in self._last_decay:
+                # No positive signal yet: start the clock at the first decay
+                # pass that sees the agent, so it decays from then on.
+                self._last_decay[agent_did] = now
+                continue
             # Measure from the later of the last positive signal and the last
             # decay pass, so repeated calls don't charge the same hours again.
             last = max(
-                self._last_positive.get(agent_did, now),
+                self._last_positive.get(agent_did, float("-inf")),
                 self._last_decay.get(agent_did, float("-inf")),
             )
             hours_since = (now - last) / 3600

@@ -239,6 +239,40 @@ def test_no_decay_for_newly_registered_agent(self):
         deltas = engine.apply_temporal_decay(now=now)
         assert deltas.get("a", 0) == 0
 
+    def test_agent_without_positive_signal_decays_after_first_pass(self):
+        """An agent that never had a positive signal decays from the first pass on."""
+        engine = NetworkTrustEngine(decay_rate=10.0)
+        engine.set_score("a", 800.0)
+        t0 = time.time()
+        assert engine.apply_temporal_decay(now=t0).get("a", 0) == 0
+
+        deltas = engine.apply_temporal_decay(now=t0 + 3600)
+        assert deltas["a"] == pytest.approx(-10.0)
+        assert engine.get_score("a") == pytest.approx(790.0)
+
+        engine.apply_temporal_decay(now=t0 + 7200)
+        assert engine.get_score("a") == pytest.approx(780.0)
+
+    def test_agent_hit_by_trust_event_decays_without_positive_signal(self):
+        """Scores created by a trust event alone are not exempt from decay."""
+        engine = NetworkTrustEngine(decay_rate=10.0)
+        engine.process_trust_event(
+            TrustEvent(agent_did="a", event_type="policy_violation", severity_weight=0.1)
+        )
+        t0 = time.time()
+        engine.apply_temporal_decay(now=t0)
+        engine.apply_temporal_decay(now=t0 + 3 * 3600)
+        assert engine.get_score("a") == pytest.approx(460.0)
+
+    def test_positive_signal_after_first_pass_restarts_the_clock(self):
+        engine = NetworkTrustEngine(decay_rate=10.0)
+        engine.set_score("a", 800.0)
+        t0 = time.time()
+        engine.apply_temporal_decay(now=t0)
+        engine._last_positive["a"] = t0 + 1800
+        deltas = engine.apply_temporal_decay(now=t0 + 3600)
+        assert deltas["a"] == pytest.approx(-5.0)
+
     def test_successive_decay_applications(self):
         """Calling apply_temporal_decay multiple times accumulates decay."""
         engine = NetworkTrustEngine(decay_rate=10.0)
